Open manifest: GET /discover or /.well-known/mcp.json (no auth, no secrets). mDNS: _mcp._tcp + _broker._tcp. Calling tools still needs the bearer token.
The token is stored encrypted on-device and never appears in /health, /discover or logs. Rotating shows the new token once.
Connection URLs ship prefilled with the built-in public mesh defaults. Edit to override; save a blank field to restore the default. Tokens and the Airtable key are never built in.
Mesh base URL (all bridges live under it)
Any Termux scripts or MCP clients using the old token stop working until you update them. The new token is shown once and copied to the clipboard.
Mic off. Tap TALK and speak — it answers out loud and keeps listening until you tap STOP or say “stop”.

Quick on-phone answers (status, “what does my last scan mean”) are instant. Everything else goes to Muse through your own ngrok host, and Muse answers out loud in its own natural male voice (Static by default; tap the voice button to pick Jordan, Morgan, Bubba, Prophet or Ronan) as an MP3. If no Muse audio arrives within 60 s, the phone reads the reply with its best male device voice instead. The mic is only on during a session. It never texts, emails, calls, or spends.
Microphone permission is needed for Talk.
Repair DataWedge profile (scans → this app, all apps)
Tap a scan below to show it. “What this means” explains each field in plain English; raw/hidden bytes follow.
Hotspot: tap Refresh or Start to read status…
Pause broker (stop background loops; MCP stays up)

Shares this phone\'s internet as "TC22-Extender" (WPA2, password made on this phone). If the phone can keep Wi-Fi and the hotspot on together it repeats your Wi-Fi; otherwise it shares mobile data. It can\'t boost other phones\' radios. It helps when the TC22 is placed where the signal is stronger. Wi-Fi detection only measures signal strength at this phone: no through-wall view, no tracking of people.
